scripts.build: bun run check && bun run build:bundle
scripts.check: bun run check:client && bun run check:node
scripts.build:browser: bun -e "process.env.GM_CLIENT_ENGINE='real'; process.env.GM_CLIENT_ALLOW_DUMMY='1'; process.env.GM_CLIENT_DEV_TOOLS='1'; process.env.GM_CLIENT_BUILD_LABEL='browser-test'; const result = Bun.spawnSync(['bun', 'run', 'build:bundle'], { cwd: '.', stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' }); process.exit(result.exitCode);"
scripts.test:browser: bun run build:browser && playwright test -c playwright.browser.config.ts
